name: Stellar Dream
source:
Stellar Dream tells a story about a colony ship set to find new worlds suitable for human colonization.
Scouts were send to three most suitable candidates but communication with them has been lost.
The player’s task is to bring the scouts home, find a suitable home for the colony and establish diplomatic relations with alien life forms.

[From [url=https://winterlook-games.itch.io/stellar-dream-049-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《星梦》讲述了一艘殖民船前往寻找适合人类殖民的新世界的故事。
球探被派往三名最合适的候选人，但与他们的联系已经中断。
玩家的任务是将侦察兵带回家，为殖民地找到合适的家园，并与外星生命形式建立外交关系。

[来自[url=https://winterlook-games.itch.io/stellar-dream-049-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
